svg.title: A finished data card, all seven lines
svg.desc: An index card headed Data Card, Sleep and School Bag, August to September 2026. Seven ruled lines are filled in: what it is, how much, who collected it, who it is about, permission, known gaps, and do not use for.
svg.text: Seven lines that make a table trustworthy
DATA CARD — Sleep & School Bag, Aug–Sep 2026

g.text: 30 school days of my own sleep, bag weight and screen time.
30 rows × 5 columns. 3 Aug to 11 Sep 2026. One row = one school day.
Me, by hand, written on paper at 21:00 every night, then typed up.
One person: me, age 11. No other people appear in this table.
My own data. A parent read it before I shared it. No names, no address.
2 nights blank (forgot). 1 sleep reading of 88 h deleted as impossible.
Guessing anyone else’s sleep. Any claim about children in general.

svg.text: The last two lines are the ones with real value. Anybody can count. Saying what you cannot claim is the skill.
